method.prediction: saved three-class node, made probability is class 1 plus class 2
method.distance_bands: training-window means, computed from the exact fitted-model cache
method.quartiles: zone-specific quantiles of input values, never observed outcomes
method.quartile_uncertainty: paired game-cluster bootstrap, added after initial bin means as a descriptive uncertainty check, not a feature-selection gate
method.limitations: conditional on actual shot and zone; defender five exposures overlap and are not on-ball attribution; actor profiles unavailable when outside recorded five
